purpose: v0.6.1: panel module selection by the ID pin (CSOT and BOE), 105C CPU hotspot trips, the built-in LLCC driver, and the touch flash fix (CPU latency limit while a GPI DMA SPI message runs, touch event page selected once per stream) on the piano32 base
note: The kernel release fragments remain in the kernel source and are merged in order. tools/build-kernel.sh then applies kernel_release to CONFIG_LOCALVERSION for package ABI allocation without a kernel-only release commit; all other configuration remains unchanged. kernel/abi.json binds the final commit and .config.
